a.xlink:title: Adjusts control sizes for consistent heights, spacing and square buttons.
Returns whether a button should automatically request square sizing.
Returns control sizes based on the widget's font and height limits.
Returns whether the widget is inside an item view.
Returns whether a control uses the standard height.
Uses the theme's table grid color and default hints for everything else.
Returns the current theme's colors and drawing resources.
Calculates control and icon sizes from the font size and height limits.
Returns whether two fonts have the same configured size.
Returns the icon's edge spacing for the control height.
Returns whether the widget is an item-view viewport.
